title: Twenty-Five Years of MIR Research: Achievements, Practices, Evaluations, and Future Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative review of the composition of major datasets (e.g., Million Song Dataset, AudioSet) and research focus, highlighting the predominance of Western classical and pop music compared to non-Western genres.
Assessment of demographic representation within the research community, specifically noting the historical gender imbalance among authors and participants at the ISMIR conference.
